external_correlations.claim_boundary: No external correlation or maturity promotion is claimed by this pack.

limitations: The official G06 gate remains NOT_STARTED; this pack is prequalification evidence only.
The G06 corpus contains seven J2 cases covering TET4, HEX8 and HEX20; no dedicated G06 TET10 J2 case is registered.
The 20-case analytical study is linear elastic, not a constitutive J2 oracle.
The four-level mesh study is limited to a uniform axial HEX8 bar and is not general J2 mesh convergence.
No compatible Code_Aster or CalculiX G06 external deck was executed in this run.
Finite-kinematic J2 and coupled nonlinear workflows remain research/experimental and are not promoted.
